'''Mishta''' was an angry [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was one of several refugees used by [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in a bombfield-running game on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]].
